8.4.6 Can_TTDisableTimeMarkIRQ
[SWS_TtCan_00106] Definition of API function Can_TTDisableTimeMarkIRQ ⌈
Service Name
Can_TTDisableTimeMarkIRQ
Syntax
void Can_TTDisableTimeMarkIRQ (
uint8 Controller
)
Service ID [hex]
0x4c
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Non Reentrant
Parameters (in)
Controller
Controller for which the time mark interrupt shall be disabled.
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
None
Description
Disables the time mark interrupt.
Available via
Ttcan.h
⌋(SRS_TtCan_41005)
[SWS_TtCan_00073] ⌈If development error detection for the Ttcan module is en-
abled: The function Can_TTDisableTimeMarkIRQ() shall raise the error CAN_E_-
UNINIT if the driver is not yet initialized.⌋()
[SWS_TtCan_00074] ⌈If development error detection for the Ttcan module is en-
abled: The function Can_TTDisableTimeMarkIRQ() shall raise the error CAN_E_-
PARAM_CONTROLLER if the parameter Controller is out of range.⌋()
